matches_scores_non_negative.name: matches_scores_non_negative
matches_scores_non_negative.value:
(home_goals IS NULL OR home_goals >= 0) AND (away_goals IS NULL OR away_goals >= 0)
        AND (ht_home_goals IS NULL OR ht_home_goals >= 0) AND (ht_away_goals IS NULL OR ht_away_goals >= 0)
        AND (aet_home_goals IS NULL OR aet_home_goals >= 0) AND (aet_away_goals IS NULL OR aet_away_goals >= 0)
        AND (pen_home IS NULL OR pen_home >= 0) AND (pen_away IS NULL OR pen_away >= 0)

matches_ht_requires_ft.name: matches_ht_requires_ft
matches_ht_requires_ft.value: ht_home_goals IS NULL OR (home_goals IS NOT NULL AND ht_home_goals <= home_goals AND ht_away_goals <= away_goals)

matches_aet_only_after_level_ft.name: matches_aet_only_after_level_ft
matches_aet_only_after_level_ft.value: aet_home_goals IS NULL OR (home_goals = away_goals AND aet_home_goals >= home_goals AND aet_away_goals >= away_goals)

matches_pens_only_when_level.name: matches_pens_only_when_level
matches_pens_only_when_level.value:
pen_home IS NULL OR (home_goals IS NOT NULL
        AND COALESCE(aet_home_goals, home_goals) = COALESCE(aet_away_goals, away_goals)
        AND pen_home <> pen_away)

matches_winner_is_participant.name: matches_winner_is_participant
matches_winner_is_participant.value: winner_entry_id IS NULL OR winner_entry_id = home_entry_id OR winner_entry_id = away_entry_id

matches_completed_has_score.name: matches_completed_has_score
matches_completed_has_score.value: NOT (status = 'completed' AND outcome_type IN ('normal', 'awarded')) OR home_goals IS NOT NULL

matches_walkover_shape.name: matches_walkover_shape
matches_walkover_shape.value:
outcome_type <> 'walkover' OR (status = 'completed' AND winner_entry_id IS NOT NULL
        AND home_goals IS NULL AND ht_home_goals IS NULL AND aet_home_goals IS NULL AND pen_home IS NULL)

matches_completed_has_kickoff.name: matches_completed_has_kickoff
matches_completed_has_kickoff.value: status <> 'completed' OR kickoff_at IS NOT NULL

matches_confirmed_has_timestamp.name: matches_confirmed_has_timestamp
matches_confirmed_has_timestamp.value: result_state <> 'confirmed' OR confirmed_at IS NOT NULL

seasons_dates_ordered.name: seasons_dates_ordered
seasons_dates_ordered.value: ends_on IS NULL OR starts_on IS NULL OR ends_on >= starts_on
